description: Native reference-distill staged recovery audit. Start from the target-only reference-root fit and distill broad behavior back toward the parent while retaining target top1.

metadata.parent_result: Corrected native-32 validation rejected the parent: model gate top1 647/1409 on oracle/child targets, corrected 300k search top1 560/1409, compare all 207 candidate-better vs 553 reference-better, capped -35908.
metadata.soft_reference_result: native-searchaware-reference-distill-init-lr5e7-e24 failed: selected checkpoint only reached 498/1400 top1 on the reference-distill model gate, versus parent baseline 491/1400 and required 540/1400.
metadata.hard_reference_result: native-searchaware-reference-distill-hard-lr5e7-e32 failed: selected checkpoint only reached 497/1400 top1, versus the required 580/1400, even with hard rank-1 policy and weaker broad init distillation.
metadata.targetonly_result: native-searchaware-reference-distill-targetonly-lr1e6-e80 passed the diagnostic: selected checkpoint reached 1072/1400 top1 and 1351/1400 top3 with exact .pt/.nn parity, but broad init drift reached about 175cp.
metadata.reference_distill_targets: runs/native-searchaware-reference-distill-hard-targets-20260525/reference_distill_hard_targets.jsonl: 1400 targets retargeted from the unified corpus to the reference engine's 300k selected root move, with policy_temperature_cp=0 and gap_floor_cp=50.
metadata.recover_result: native-searchaware-reference-distill-recover-lr2e7-e80 retained target top1, but target-best checkpoint selection saved epoch 0. Later epochs had lower broad drift (~105cp) while still retaining about 1052/1400 target top1.
metadata.hypothesis: Save the final recovery epoch instead of target-best epoch, so the model keeps lower broad drift while retaining most target top1.
metadata.gate: Recovery audit only. The exported .pt/.nn model gate must retain at least 950/1400 top1 before any corrected native-32 10k engine gate is considered.
metadata.decision: If target retention passes, run only a corrected native-32 unified 10k gate. If target retention fails or broad search is not better than parent, close staged reference-root recovery.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must retain at least 950/1400 top1 on the hard reference-root corpus.
validation.first_search_gate_if_model_passes: Run corrected native-32 search_target_gate with --require-native-net-load on the unified corpus at 10k nodes.
validation.hard_stop: Do not SPRT unless the corrected 10k and then 300k gates beat the parent.
